prDescription:
This PR adds a poem about dogs to the readme file (File.md) as requested. The poem is titled "Faithful Friend" and celebrates the special bond between humans and dogs.

The poem highlights:
- The loyal companionship dogs provide
- The joy they bring to our lives
- Their playful and adventurous nature
- The enduring bond they share with their owners

I've maintained the existing content of the file while adding this new creative element.

Fixes #16.
